title: Western South Atlantic humpback whale population

source.name: Population assessments of the Western South Atlantic humpback whale breeding stock
source.publisher: NOAA Fisheries, citing peer-reviewed population studies (Ward et al., International Whaling Commission)

notes: Commercial whaling reduced this population to roughly 450 individuals by the mid-1950s. A mark-recapture study using 1996-2000 photo-ID data produced a growth-adjusted estimate of about 3,871 whales for the year 2000. Recent surveys (reported by NOAA and multiple outlets in 2025-2026) put the population at approximately 25,000, close to its pre-whaling size.
